items.title: Brewers, Packers allow the 1-9 Milwaukee Bucks to fly under the radar, for now - the latest from Lori Nickel.
items.author: Jim Owczarski
items.body_excerpt:
Brewers, Packers allow the 1-9 Milwaukee Bucks to fly under the radar, for now - the latest from Lori Nickel.

But she doesn’t take it easy:

“I don’t get how people say they’re fun to watch. How is a foot race to perpetual losing fun?”

quote.author: KeithSmithNBA
quote.text:
Every Knicks-Sixers box score from last night lists the Knicks as having 16 active players for the game. Teams can't have more than 15 players active for a game.

Anyone have any idea what happened here? Jose Alvarado was inactive. The other inactive matters for two-way counts.
